verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a Zapier-style automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents a schedule, cron, or recurring trigger. Docs say flows start with a trigger (activepieces-docs-21) without naming a time-based one. The changelog line "summarise my unread emails every morning" (activepieces-docs-8) is an example prompt for drafting an agent, not documented recurring-schedule support. Since the axis applies but nothing in the pack shows the product delivers it, the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
